The plan uses three trips and defers 4 adults. It was worked out by hand and not checked against a solver.

- **car1, first trip:** Go to Trishuli village via Bidur temple and pick up the 3 injured. On the way back, pick up 1 adult at Bidur temple, then drop all 4 at the shelter. This takes 48 minutes.
- **car2:** Go to Syaphru farm via Bidur temple and pick up the 3 elderly. On the way back, pick up 1 adult at Bidur temple, then drop all 4 at the shelter. This takes 56 minutes.
- **car1, second trip:** Drive the 48-minute road to Kakani temple, pick up 3 elderly and 1 adult, and return. This takes 96 minutes and avoids 170 in penalties, so it is worth doing.
- **Deferred:** 3 adults at Kakani temple and 1 adult at Bidur temple. Another Kakani trip costs 96 minutes to avoid only 60 in penalties. A Bidur-only trip costs 34 minutes to avoid only 20.

Cost: 48 + 56 + 96 = 200 driving minutes, plus 4 deferred adults × 20 = 80, for a total of 280.
